# Idea Scoring Rubric

Score each idea 1-5 on these dimensions:

| Criterion              | 1 (Poor)                                     | 5 (Excellent)                                                  |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Pain Severity**      | Nice-to-have                                 | Hair-on-fire problem                                           |
| **Market Size**        | Tiny niche                                   | Large addressable market                                       |
| **Competition**        | Dominated by well-funded players             | Fragmented or outdated incumbents                              |
| **Solo-Buildable**     | Needs a team, complex infra                  | One dev can ship MVP in 4-6 weeks                              |
| **Domain Fit**         | No access to customers, steep learning curve | Founder has expertise OR clear path to learn + customer access |
| **Recurring Value**    | One-time use                                 | Daily/weekly essential workflow                                |
| **Willingness to Pay** | Expects free                                 | Already paying for alternatives                                |
| **Well vs Crater**     | Broad but shallow appeal (crater)            | Narrow but deep/urgent appeal (well)                           |

**Total Score**: Sum of all criteria (max 40)

---

## The Well vs Crater Filter (Paul Graham)

> "The question to ask is not 'who wants this?' but 'who wants this so much that they'll use it even when it's a crappy version one made by a two-person startup?'"

**Craters (BAD):** Broad but shallow appeal — lots of people mildly interested, but no one desperate  
**Wells (GOOD):** Narrow but deep appeal — small number of people who want it urgently

**Practical test:** Can you identify 5-10 specific people/companies who would use a crappy MVP _right now_? If not, you likely don't have a validated need.

---

## Score Interpretation

| Score Range | Interpretation                                                    |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 32-40       | Strong candidate - prioritize for deep dive                       |
| 24-31       | Promising - worth further validation                              |
| 16-23       | Weak - needs significant angle improvement or should be abandoned |
| Below 16    | Abandon - fundamental issues with the opportunity                 |
